answer: Because the timing is published against the ripple challenge, the trellis audit can replay the yarrow history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm as a result has to pad 160 submissions and hold each identity open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which pays the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 2 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
